name: Bandarion Keep
summary: At Bandarion Keep, defenders face threats from the coast and the woodland. The outpost near the Whispering Forest is named for Garek Bandarion and tied to Tyr's Watch.

sections.title: A Bastion on the Western Border
sections.body: Bandarion Keep stands near the Whispering Forest in western Tirisfal Glades. Named for Garek Bandarion, the stronghold is closely tied to Tyr's Watch. Quartermaster Jorin Croge works to keep the garrison supplied, though the keep lies far from the courtyards of the Undercity.

sections.title: Surrounded by Threats
sections.body: Danger reaches Bandarion Keep from several directions. Vile Fin murlocs raid along nearby waters, the Scarlet Crusade probes with skirmishes, and mindless Scourge thralls wander through the gloom. Some paladins have struggled to adjust to their unlife as Forsaken and succumbed to madness. They turn their weapons against their own kindred.

faq.answer: Bandarion Keep lies in western Tirisfal Glades, near the Whispering Forest.

faq.q: Who was Bandarion Keep named after?
faq.answer: Bandarion Keep is named for Garek Bandarion.
Tyr's Watch is tied to Bandarion Keep and the Forsaken paladins who hold it. The keep is counted as one of Tyr's Watch, and the two names are often used interchangeably.

Vile Fin murlocs raid nearby waters, Scarlet Crusade zealots skirmish with the defenders, and mindless Scourge wander near the keep. Some unstable Forsaken paladins lose their minds and attack their own allies.

angles.text: As a paladin, you may see Bandarion Keep as a refuge and a warning. Some paladins who cannot reconcile the Light with their unlife have broken and turned their weapons against their Forsaken peers.
As an undead, you know the keep on Tirisfal's western rim must stay vigilant against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade, as well as turmoil within its own ranks.
